decisions.reason: GA4 is now the mandatory Google Analytics standard, so shop clients keep needing a GA4 tracking plugin and it fits the firm's analytics services.
Google stopped processing data for standard Universal Analytics in July 2023 and fully shuts it down in 2024, so the plugin loses its purpose and clients will migrate to GA4.
Interfaces between shops and retail systems are a lasting integration need that fits the firm's plugin and interface development skills and supports recurring client relationships.
Relaunch SEO support is a low-cost consulting service that links directly to the firm's core shop relaunch projects and is prominently marketed on its own page.
